svg.title: Trained on SUES-200 → evaluated on University-1652
svg.desc: Three-seed mean and sample SD. SD uses denominator 2, not confidence intervals. Native editable text and shapes. R@1 and official trapezoidal mAP percentages; MRR multiplied by 100. Tasks remain separate.
svg.text: Trained on SUES-200 → evaluated on University-1652
Bars are sample SD (n − 1 = 2), not confidence intervals or significance tests.
Each retrieval task is separate; no pooling across heights, directions or datasets.
R@1 and mAP are percentages; MRR × 100 is scaled MRR, not an accuracy percentage.
Labels show mean ± sample SD; exact fractions and all seed values are in the source tables.
